% Main half of the cross-document reference pair. Pairs with xr-appendix.tex:
% each resolves \externaldocument against the other's .aux, which only exists once
% that document has been built, so a build order that finalises one before compiling
% the other leaves these references undefined.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{xr}
\externaldocument[A-]{xr-appendix}
\begin{document}
\section{Body}\label{sec:body}
Same-document reference: Section~\ref{sec:body}.
Cross-document reference: see Appendix~\ref{A-app:proof}.
\end{document}
